OAI.LargePrimeGaps.siegelWalfisz : OAI.LargePrimeGaps.SiegelWalfisz
OAI.LargePrimeGaps.bombieriVinogradov : OAI.LargePrimeGaps.BombieriVinogradov
def OAI.LargePrimeGaps.SiegelWalfisz : Prop :=
∀ (A B : ℝ),
  0 < A →
    0 < B →
      ∃ M,
        0 < M ∧
          ∃ x₀,
            1 < x₀ ∧
              ∀ (x : ℝ),
                x₀ ≤ x →
                  ∀ (d : ℕ),
                    0 < d →
                      ↑d ≤ Real.log x ^ B →
                        ∀ (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d),
                          χ.IsPrimitive → ‖OAI.LargePrimeGaps.primeCharacterError x χ‖ ≤ M * x * Real.log x ^ (-A)
def OAI.LargePrimeGaps.BombieriVinogradov : Prop :=
∀ (A : ℝ),
  0 < A →
    ∃ b,
      0 < b ∧
        ∃ M,
          0 < M ∧
            ∃ x₀,
              1 < x₀ ∧
                ∀ (x : ℝ),
                  x₀ ≤ x →
                    ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x ^ (1 / 2) * Real.log x ^ (-b)⌋₊, ↑(OAI.LargePrimeGaps.endpointError x q) ≤
                      M * x * Real.log x ^ (-A)
'OAI.LargePrimeGaps.siegelWalfisz' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'OAI.LargePrimeGaps.bombieriVinogradov' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'transcribed_SW_holds' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'transcribed_BV_holds' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
